verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents a token-authenticated API that it says can do 'anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI'. It also offers bot tokens for non-user automation and an official MCP server built on an OpenAPI spec of the FireHydrant API. Together these cover the core of a no-dashboard agent loop over incidents and alerts, and acknowledgement and escalation policies exist as documented concepts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of acknowledge, escalate and resolve endpoints or MCP tools, a publicly hosted OpenAPI spec at the docs domain (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent workflow.
